name: Accenting — Extra at the Frenulum
summary: Male variant of Accenting. Pleasure isn't even across the penis—the frenulum is usually the standout. Take a working stroke and add one firmer, deeper, or slower accent right at the frenulum on each pass.
detailed_description: Accenting means giving a little extra where it matters most rather than treating everything equally. On the penis that spot is most often the frenulum on the underside of the head. Starting from a stroke both partners already enjoy, accent just one part of it—press a touch harder, linger, or sweep a little faster—each time you cross the frenulum. The rest of the motion stays the same so the accent stands out and repetition still builds.
stepwise_structure: 1. Start from a stroke that already feels good (e.g., up/down the shaft).
2. Keep the base motion steady and repeatable.
3. Each time you cross the frenulum, accent it—firmer, slower, or a small extra circle.
4. Return to the base motion between accents.
5. Test other spots (corona, a particular side) for a personal standout.
safety_notes: Don't accent so hard it becomes sharp—extra, not painful.
The standout spot can shift day to day; keep checking in.
